statement: HHD's source explicitly associates gyro-timestamp-synchronized report emission with improving Steam gyro-to-mouse; its readme gives Steam motion-axis setup instructions. These documented consumer accommodations show a plausible UHID DualSense gyro path without dummy_hcd, but do not expose Steam's closed-source detection rules, prove HHD's current runtime compatibility on this project's host, or establish an SDL HIDAPI result for the exact HHD pin. The historical virtualgamepad assertion of a necessary dummy_hcd path is therefore not a protocol theorem.
